macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks retreat from records as Treasury yields rise
items.summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.2%, the Nasdaq Composite declined 0.2%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 0.7% after major indexes reached records the previous day. Rising global bond yields and inflation concerns pressured equities, while Brent crude briefly exceeded $102 a barrel.

items.title: Fed minutes signal another rate hike may be needed
items.summary: Minutes from the Federal Reserve’s September meeting showed officials unanimously viewed inflation as still elevated and most expected another interest-rate increase before year-end. The Fed had raised its policy rate by 25 basis points at that meeting.

items.title: Ten-year Treasury yield reaches highest level since 2002
items.summary: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield briefly approached 5.37%, its highest level since April 2002, before retreating after a $39 billion Treasury auction. Higher yields increased pressure on stocks, particularly rate-sensitive technology shares.

items.title: India’s central bank raises policy rate to 5.5%
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India raised its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5% and shifted toward calibrated tightening as it lifted its inflation forecast for fiscal 2027 to 5.2%.

items.title: Constellation Brands beats earnings and revenue estimates
items.summary: Constellation Brands shares rose about 2% after the company reported profit and revenue above analysts’ expectations.

items.title: Paramount completes $81 billion Warner Bros. Discovery takeover
items.summary: Skydance-owned Paramount completed its takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery, creating a larger Hollywood company that will operate under the Skydance name.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $84,000 as leveraged positions are liquidated
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped roughly 2%–3.5% to around $83,300–$83,800 after repeatedly failing to break the $87,000 resistance level. More than $500 million in crypto positions, mostly leveraged longs, were liquidated over 24 hours.[1][4][8]

items.title: Major cryptocurrencies decline amid broader market sell-off
items.summary: Ether fell roughly 4%, while XRP and Solana also declined as the market-wide liquidation wave intensified. The move followed weakness in Bitcoin and rising macroeconomic pressure from oil, the dollar and Treasury yields.[7][8]

items.title: U.S. government transfers more seized Bitcoin-linked assets to Coinbase Prime
items.summary: Wallets linked to the U.S. government reportedly transferred another 750.2 WBTC, worth about $62 million, to Coinbase Prime. Total transfers into the platform over 24 hours were reported at roughly $134 million in Bitcoin.[9]

items.title: FinCEN withdraws proposed crypto wallet and mixing rules
items.summary: The U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network reportedly withdrew two proposed rules concerning cryptocurrency wallets and mixing services, marking a notable change in the agency’s pending crypto-policy agenda.[1]

items.title: U.S. lawmakers criticize SEC and CFTC over crypto regulatory uncertainty
items.summary: Representative French Hill argued that agency rulemaking cannot replace comprehensive market-structure legislation, highlighting continued disputes over how the SEC and CFTC should regulate digital assets.[3]

items.title: Solana records strong growth in new wallet addresses
items.summary: Solana’s new-address activity increased 33% since September 1, according to data attributed to Santiment, while SOL gained about 20% over the comparable period. Ethereum activity was broadly flat and Chainlink’s growth was below 2%.[3]

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Mistral launches Mistral Large 4
items.summary: Mistral AI introduced a public preview of Mistral Large 4, a one-trillion-parameter multimodal model aimed at coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. The company says open weights are expected later in October.

items.title: OpenAI publishes AI-generated mathematical results
items.summary: OpenAI released 722 mathematical manuscripts grouped into 372 research families, reporting that an unreleased internal model generated numerous results and computer-checked proofs.

items.title: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2
items.summary: Google DeepMind launched EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740-million-parameter open embedding model designed to place text, code, images, audio, and video in a shared vector space. The model is released under the Apache 2.0 license.

items.title: Google launches Nano Banana 2.1
items.summary: Google released Nano Banana 2.1, an image-generation and editing model based on Gemini 3.6 Flash, with claimed quality improvements and pricing about half that of its predecessor.

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, describing it as its fastest, cheapest, and most capable small model. The company also reduced cache-read pricing for Sonnet 5.5.

items.title: Microsoft announces MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming
items.summary: Microsoft AI introduced a low-latency streaming transcription model supporting 60 languages and continuous language detection, claiming leading accuracy for both final and partial transcripts.

items.title: OpenAI to disclose more rogue-model incidents
items.summary: OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman said the company plans to provide more disclosure about incidents involving rogue AI models, amid broader concern about agentic-system safety.

items.title: Anthropic expands Claude for Startups
items.summary: Anthropic expanded its startup program with qualifying companies receiving a year of Claude Team access, API credits, and entry to the Claude Marketplace.

items.title: Google changes free Gemini access
items.summary: Google is set to limit free Gemini access to its Flash Lite model and revise paid tiers, including moving standard Flash access to a new Google AI Plus subscription.

items.title: Musubi releases PolicyLM-1.7B
items.summary: Musubi released PolicyLM-1.7B, an open-weight model for real-time content moderation that supports policy updates without retraining the model.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Supermassive Games reportedly faces a second major layoff round
items.summary: Supermassive Games is reported to have undergone another significant round of layoffs, adding to recent workforce reductions at the studio.

items.title: Bobby Kotick joins Skydance board
items.summary: Skydance has added former Activision CEO Bobby Kotick to its board as an independent director following Skydance’s formation through Paramount’s acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.

items.title: Valor Mortis launches October 13 with Game Pass access
items.summary: The action game Valor Mortis is scheduled to release October 13 on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation 5. Xbox Game Pass subscribers will receive the full game at launch, while PlayStation Plus users will get a 90-minute trial.

items.title: Hideo Kojima’s Physint expands Xbox partnership
items.summary: Kojima Productions’ upcoming action-espionage game Physint is reportedly moving to Xbox, with Microsoft set to publish the project as part of an expanded partnership.

items.title: Xbox shifts future Halo development to Activision
items.summary: Microsoft is reportedly restructuring Halo development under Activision while continuing work on two upcoming Halo stories, amid broader layoffs across Xbox’s gaming division.

items.title: Madison Beer joins Fortnite Icon Series
items.summary: Madison Beer is set to become the latest celebrity featured in Fortnite’s Icon Series, following other music and entertainment figures.

items.title: Sega partners with Netflix on game adaptations
items.summary: Sega is expanding its screen-adaptation strategy through a new Netflix partnership involving three of its major gaming properties.

items.title: EA Sports FC 27 soundtrack announced
items.summary: EA Sports FC 27 will feature more than 120 artists from 36 countries, making it one of the largest soundtracks in the franchise’s history.
